When you live to love, you realise it’s a bad way to live. But you can’t really turn back.
Sometimes I wish I could go back to not caring. I mean, I don’t know if I had armour, but back in the day I definitely didn’t feel so damn lonely just cause I didn’t have a partner.

You always want what you don’t have.

Everyone else was dealing with their own shit and I felt isolated because I felt like no one was mature as me. Now I feel like the immature one because everyone seems to have grown up a bit while im still just doing what I want but still feeling depressed.
